title: Chapter 615 - 615 Kill; Harvest!
content:
Chapter 615 - 615 Kill; Harvest!

Chapter 615 - 615 Kill; Harvest!

615 Kill; Harvest!

The ancient and majestic Little Thunderclap Monastery had long since collapsed completely from the battle between Lin Fan and the monster, turning into a pile of ruins.

Sam, Abraham, and the Heavenly Hound stood quietly at the side without moving.

Sam and Abraham were shocked by the monster’s terrifying aura.

The Heavenly Hound received Lin Fan’s signal that it did not need its help.

The sun shot out a dazzling light, making the entire forbidden area seem like a huge furnace. It was extremely hot.

A gust of wind blew, stirring up the hot sand.

“Make the sand disappear?” The monster laughed. “Hahaha!”

It was as if it had heard the funniest joke in the world, and its entire body began to sway.

Lin Fan said calmly, “That’s right!”

As soon as he finished speaking, the originally cloudless sky suddenly became covered with dark clouds.

A thunderclap sounded, forming countless ferocious lightning snakes that swam crazily in the air. It was as if they wanted to tear the sky into countless pieces.

Then, bean-sized raindrops fell.

The heroes of the various countries were thirsty to begin with.

This sudden rainstorm was simply a life-saving thing for them.

The heroes opened their mouths and drank to their satisfaction.

In the next moment, the soft sand under their feet gradually solidified and hardened!

From golden yellow, it gradually turned gray!

The heroes were surprised to find that all the sand had turned into normal soil!

While they were still in shock, the gray surface began to move at a speed visible to the naked eye. Emerald grass and thick trees grew!

There were endless grasslands and overlapping forests!

Everyone was stunned.

The lifeless desert was like a forest!

A miracle!

In fact, it was not just the heroes of the various countries who were stunned.

The Heavenly Hound… and even the huge monster was stunned.

Their faces were filled with disbelief.

After a while, the monster shouted, “Where’s the desert?” Where is my desert?

“No!

“No, it can’t be! This must be an illusion!

“Yes, it’s an illusion!”

The desert was the root of its life!

If the desert was gone… then it…

Lin Fan said, “Whether it’s an illusion or not, you’ll know once you experience it.”

As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Fan raised the Star Meteorite Sword up high and brought it down.

[Skill: Sword 8!]

A vast sword light swept out with a terrifying aura.

This sword light completely illuminated the monster’s eyes.

For the first time, fear appeared on its ferocious face.

The monster hurriedly moved its body, wanting to dodge the sword light.

However, the speed of the sword light was too fast, and it could not react in time at all.

“No!”

The sword light descended!

The monster’s body and the solid ground were split into two.

Hot blood sprayed into the bottomless ravine.

For a long time, not a single grain of sand flew to the monster.

The monster’s body could no longer be closed or repaired.

In fact, this was normal.

One had to know…

Lin Fan had Advanced Earth Manipulation Technique that could easily change the nature of the land. For example, turning the desert into soil, turning soil into rocks, and so on.

However, this forbidden area was too big.

n addition, Lin Fan wanted to be on the safe side.

He also used the Advanced Lightning Control Technique and Advanced Water Control Technique to make the sky rain heavily.

Then, he used Advanced Earth Manipulation Technique to grow a dense forest on the ground.

Rain could grow trees, trees could gather soil, and soil could change sand!

These abilities stacked together and finally turned the entire forbidden area into an oasis!

Changing the world was nothing more than this!

At this moment, an emotionless voice sounded.

[The first to kill a level-ten Sand Python King. You’ve obtained a level-ten treasure chest.]

[The first to kill a level-ten Sand Python King. Hua Nation has gained a large mineral vein.]

[The first to destroy a level-nine forbidden area. You’ve obtained a level-nine mysterious treasure chest.]

[The first to destroy a level-nine forbidden area. A forbidden area has descended Hua Nation.]

…

Then, Lin Fan waved his hand and opened the level-ten treasure chest.

[You’ve received 1,000 Constitution points. Do you want to use them?]

Then, he opened the level-nine mystery treasure chest.

[You’ve received Beginner Metal Manipulation Technique. Do you want to use it?]

At the same time, two crisp notifications rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—10,000 Constitution points.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—Advanced Metal Manipulation Technique.]

Instantly, Lin Fan’s strength surged.

Then, countless metallic particles appeared in his vision.

Lin Fan had a very clear feeling that as long as he willed it, these metal particles would quickly gather together, forming a huge metal block or even a towering metal mountain. He could even change its shape at will.

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Xiao Bing’s eyes were wide open, and she forgot to close her mouth. She was unable to say a word.

The comments in the live broadcast room were like a storm.

BroadSky: [Who can tell me what happened just now?]

[Illusion: [God Lin killed the Sand Python King! Moreover, he turned the desert into an oasis!]

Sunny Day: [Lightning, rain, earth, trees! God Lin is awesome!]

Liang Keqi: [God Lin is the best!]

Rider: [I’m dumbfounded!]

The Wind Rises: [When the Sand Python King said that as long as there’s sand, it won’t die, I really broke out in a cold sweat for God Lin.]

Choice: [This live broadcast is so enjoyable!]

Bad Boy: [God Lin is awesome!]

…

Heartache 2009: [Oh right, didn’t another forbidden area descend? Where is it this time?]

Sell: [It’s my place! Yong City! A golden desert suddenly appeared in the south of Yong City!]

Life Is Like This: [Desert? Did any special changes happen to you?]

Basketball Fire: [I’m from Yong City South District! I suddenly felt my body become filled with power!]

Reborn: [Me too! I just casually jumped and easily touched the basketball basket!]

Big Shot: [I just ran to the fifth floor and didn’t have to catch my breath!]

Step 1: [F*ck! Touching the basket! I’m going to the south of Yong City now.]

SmokeTasty: [I want to go too.]

800 Million: [I’m going too!]

…

Hence, many people began to head to the south of Yong City.

However, most of them were destined to return empty-handed.

When they arrived at the south of Yong City, all the intersections had been surrounded by soldiers and no one was allowed to enter.

…

Lin Fan was completely oblivious to all of this.

Of course, he would not mind.

He could feel the increase in power in his body and the wonderful Advanced Metal Manipulation Technique. The corners of his mouth curled up slightly.

“Heavenly Hound, use these 1,000 Constitution points and Beginner Metal Manipulation Skill.”

As soon as he finished speaking, he waved his hand and the two balls of light entered the Heavenly Hound’s body.

Instantly, the entire body of the Heavenly Hound was filled with a surging aura.
